# faq-from-docs

> Generate FAQ entries from Markdown documentation with an injected LLM, one cited section per answer, verbatim quote checks, question deduplication and Markdown output Python package `trysac-faq-from-docs`, import name `faq_from_docs`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): commands, folder map, conventions, limits
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the package and its public API
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
